song2025rekgmcts.verified_prose_claim: ReKG-MCTS applies MCTS to external knowledge graphs; its tree nodes represent partial reasoning paths, with LLM-guided expansion and rollouts used to answer questions.
content_locations: Section 2.3 node selection and path expansion
song2025rekgmcts.claim_boundaries: Do not claim it cannot traverse cycles or prove universal absence of SCC handling. The verified task and output are KG question answering and reasoning paths.
